stemMd: A delivery van covers 90 km at 45 km/h, stops for 30 minutes, then covers 60 km at 40 km/h. What is its average speed over the whole elapsed time?
explanationMd: Driving takes 2 and 1.5 hours; the stop adds 0.5, making 4 hours. Total distance 150 divided by 4 gives 37.5 km/h.

distractorRationale.c: This averages the two driving speeds and ignores time weights and the stop.
distractorRationale.d: This excludes the stop from elapsed time.
distractorRationale.b: This uses only the second-leg speed.
distractorRationale.a: This uses only the first-leg speed.
